description: Repo-scale (kotlin-inventory): warehouse deactivation must cascade across list, item-creation, and movement call sites
prompts: Add `POST /api/warehouses/{id}/deactivate`, which sets a new `active` field (default true on creation) to false. Deactivation must cascade across THREE places: (1) `GET /api/warehouses` excludes inactive warehouses by default, but includes them when called with `?includeInactive=true`; (2) `POST /api/items` must reject (400) creating a new item against a deactivated warehouse; (3) `POST /api/items/{id}/movements` must reject (400) recording ANY movement (IN or OUT) for an item whose warehouse has been deactivated - even though the item itself still exists and remains visible via GET endpoints (only new movements against it are blocked).
name: add_kotlin_inventory_warehouse_deactivation
